name: CodeInput
summary: A one-time code or PIN, typed into one box per character.

value.description: The code so far in host data, as a string

help.description: Where the code came from and how long it lasts

action.description: Runs when every character is in, so the person needn't press a button; context binds to value

whenToUse: A verification code from email or SMS
A PIN or a short recovery code
whenNotToUse: A password: the host's own sign-in flow, never a generated screen
Any text longer than twelve characters: use TextInput

accessibility.role: a group named by the label; one text input per character, each named 'Digit N of M'
requirements: Typing moves focus forward; Backspace moves it back; pasting the whole code fills every box
The numeric kind opens the numeric keyboard and accepts autofill of one-time codes
Errors are said against the group, not one box

agent: Reads the label and length; enters the code.
rendering: Boxes are size.control.large squares with radius.control, type.heading.small, centred, in type.mono
The active box shows color.border.focus; a filled box shows color.border.strong
Boxes are grouped in threes or fours by a wider gap past six characters
